test.create_query: CREATE TABLE index_test_integer_cast ( ts UInt64 CODEC(Delta, ZSTD), ts_signed Int64 CODEC(Delta, ZSTD), ts_nullable Nullable(UInt64) CODEC(Delta, ZSTD), flag UInt8 CODEC(Delta, ZSTD), t DateTime('UTC') ALIAS ts, t_nullable Nullable(DateTime('UTC')) ALIAS ts_nullable, u32 UInt32 ALIAS ts_signed, b Bool ALIAS flag, INDEX i_ts ts TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1, INDEX i_ts_signed ts_signed TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1, INDEX i_ts_nullable ts_nullable TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1, INDEX i_flag flag TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO index_test_integer_cast SELECT 1700000000 + number, 1700000000 + number, 1700000000 + number, (number % 100000000) < 8192 FROM numbers_mt(toUInt64(0x100000000 / 20)) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT count() FROM index_test_integer_cast WHERE t >= '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND t < '2024-01-01 00:10:00'
SELECT count() FROM index_test_integer_cast WHERE toDateTime(ts_signed, 'UTC') >= '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND toDateTime(ts_signed, 'UTC') < '2024-01-01 00:10:00'
SELECT count() FROM index_test_integer_cast WHERE t_nullable >= '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND t_nullable < '2024-01-01 00:10:00'
SELECT count() FROM index_test_integer_cast WHERE u32 >= 1704067200 AND u32 < 1704067800
SELECT count() FROM index_test_integer_cast WHERE b = true
